keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «티라노사우루스가 우리 학교에 온다(놀라운 일)» 와 «이제 그 공룡은 최고의 반 친구다(결말)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the surprise (a T. rex comes to our school) and the ending (now the T. rex is the best classmate ever). The green sentences are the answers.

qs.q: Why does the T. rex write with his tail?
opts: His arms are too short to hold a pencil.
His tail is his favorite pencil.
evs: His arms are too short to hold a pencil.
But the T. rex just sits down in the classroom.
At lunch, he eats twenty sandwiches.
At recess, he gives us rides on his back.
why: «His arms are too short to hold a pencil.» 팔이 너무 짧아서 연필을 쥘 수 없어요. 그래서 꼬리로 써요.
His arms are too short to hold a pencil, so he writes with his tail.

qs.q: "Everyone screams and runs." What does "screams" mean here?
qs.qko: «Everyone screams and runs.» 에서 «screams» 는 무슨 뜻일까요?
evs: One day, a T. rex comes to our school!
So we help him write with his tail.
Now the T. rex is the best classmate ever!
why: «One day, a T. rex comes to our school!» 커다란 공룡이 갑자기 나타나서 모두 깜짝 놀라요. 그래서 «screams» 는 무서워서 크게 소리 지른다는 뜻이에요.
A big T. rex suddenly comes to school, so everyone is scared. "Screams" means shouts loudly because of fear.

qs.q: Why is the T. rex the best classmate ever?
opts: He wants to learn with us, and he gives us rides on his back.
He eats all of our lunch.
evs: At recess, he gives us rides on his back.
At lunch, he eats twenty sandwiches.
why: 쉬는 시간에 우리를 등에 태워 주고(«At recess, he gives us rides on his back.»), 우리 교실에서 함께 배우고 싶어 해요(«He wants to learn!»). 두 문장을 이어야 알 수 있어요.
He gives us rides on his back at recess, and he wants to learn in our class. You need both sentences.

ends: The T. rex brings his baby brother to school.
Our class goes on a field trip on the T. rex’s back.
우리 반이 티라노사우루스의 등을 타고 현장 학습을 간다.

write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «하고 싶은 일 + 그 이유» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write what you want to do and your reason in English.
write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «because» 뒤에 «누가 + 무엇을» 넣어 이유를 분명하게 써 보세요. (예: because my friend likes it)
write.moreEn: One more step: after «because», write who + what to make your reason clear. (e.g. because my friend likes it)
write.src: “I want to <u>ride on a T. rex</u> because <u>it looks fun</u>.”

img.cover: On a sunny school playground at recess, a big friendly green T. rex with tiny short arms and a wide happy smile gives a girl with two curly puffballs of hair in an orange T-shirt and jean overalls and three laughing classmates a ride on his back, while other kids cheer and wave.

scenes.1: In a bright classroom, a big friendly green T. rex with tiny short arms and a wide happy smile sits on the floor among small desks and holds a big pencil with the tip of his tail, while a girl with two curly puffballs of hair in an orange T-shirt and jean overalls helps guide the pencil across a giant sheet of paper, making a big wobbly line.
scenes.2: In a sunny school lunchroom, a big friendly green T. rex with tiny short arms and a wide happy smile happily munches a tall stack of sandwiches at a long table, while a girl with two curly puffballs of hair in an orange T-shirt and jean overalls and her classmates laugh and count them on their fingers.
